jobs.title: Technical Product Owner | Integrations (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.

In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.

We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.

This role is technical, but you won't be writing the code

You'll design API surfaces, debate OAuth and webhook patterns, and hold your own with senior engineers and external partner teams. The engineers write the code. Your job is to read it when needed, sketch API designs, argue technical trade-offs, and make sure what we ship is well architected. An engineering background, or serious hands-on coding experience, is what gets you that credibility.

Location & work mode

Berlin-based, minimum 3 days a week in-office, up to 2 days optional home office. We build better in the same room. Decisions happen faster, products ship faster, and the team stays sharper. EU work permit required.

What you'll do

  • Own integrations, the public API, and webhooks end-to-end: strategy, spec, build, launch, measure
  • Build the tools that turn our AI agents from clever responders into systems that close loops: agent to CRM, agent to appointment, agent to handover, agent to custom workflow
  • Stay close to customers and partners every week, in direct calls, by talking to CS, sales, and BD, and by digging into the data yourself
  • Embed with 4 to 6 engineers, set the metric, and own whether it moves

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager, Trust Platform- Digital Identities (f/m/d) - 1 year fixed contract
jobs.description:
IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention. Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability.

The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France, and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries.

 

 

This position is based in Rennes/Paris, France OR in Berlin/Munich, Germany and a fixed term(full time) contract of 1 year as a maternity replacement. 

 

As (Senior) Product Manager, Trust Platform – Digital Identities(f/m/d), you own the product direction for how IDnow's Trust Platform supports European eID schemes and EUDI Wallets. You define the strategy for digital identity methods, act as the counterpart to IDnow's Trust Services team, and ensure the platform stays ahead of eIDAS 2.0 requirements as they become mandatory across the EU.   • Identity Interoperability: Ensure seamless cross-border identity verification, managing the nuances of different EU member state requirements, national eID schemes, and trust frameworks. 
  • Conversion Optimization: Analyze the friction-versus-security trade-off for each identification method and provide clear recommendations to help customers maximize their onboarding rates. 
  • Own the end-to-end specification of eID and EUDI Wallet integrations, going into technical detail on protocols, data models, and trust frameworks.

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner
jobs.description:
🏢 Who we are
 A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone
 We are a software company developing a zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.
 Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open-source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.
 Want to see what we're working on? Check out our GitHub repo at https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird or https://netbird.io/knowledge-hub 
 
 ✏️ What you will do 
 As a Technical Product Owner at NetBird, you'll be the link between our users and our engineering team on the core NetBird platform. That means the clients, the dashboard and API, and the self-hosted setup. Today our CTO covers product next to running engineering, and you'll take over a big part of the day to day. You keep the backlog in Linear in good shape, turn feedback from customers and the community into clear, well-scoped work and make sure engineers can spend their time building. You'll report to our CTO and work closely with engineering, support and sales.
 You will:
 Own the day-to-day backlog in Linear. Triage incoming issues, write clear tickets with context and acceptance criteria and keep priorities current.

 Build a simple system for collecting feedback from customers, GitHub issues, community channels, support and sales calls, and turn it into well-framed problems the team can act on.

 Talk to users and customers directly to understand their setups and the problem behind each request.

 Plan our regular cycles with engineering, break bigger features into shippable pieces, and follow them through to release.

 Keep the rest of the company in the loop on what's shipping, from release notes and changelogs to updates for sales and support.

 Close the loop with the people who gave feedback, so they know what happened with it.

 Spot patterns across feedback and bring them into roadmap discussions, backed by data where you can.

 This is a technical product owner role. You won't write production code, but unlike a classic product owner you'll go deep with engineers on how things work, reproduce issues yourself and judge how much effort a request really takes. It's also a hands-on role in a small team. There's no big product org around you yet, so you'll help shape how product work runs at NetBird as we grow.
 
 🔎 What we are looking for 
 We're looking for someone who is at home in technical conversations, both with our engineers and with our users, who mostly work in IT and infrastructure teams. You also like structure and keep a busy backlog in order.
 Must-Haves 
 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in a similar role at a (technical) B2B SaaS, infrastructure, or developer tools company.

 A technical background. You're comfortable reading API docs, following a GitHub discussion, and digging into how something works together with engineers.

 Understanding of networking basics like IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, and VPNs.

 Hands-on experience running a backlog in Linear, Jira, or similar, and writing tickets engineers can pick up without a follow-up meeting.

 Experience working directly with customers or users and turning their feedback into prioritized work.

 Good judgment on priorities. You can say no, explain why, and keep people aligned.

 Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. You default to writing things down.

 You work AI native. You use AI tools and coding agents every day, for example to sort feedback, dig into a problem or draft tickets, and you know where they help and where they don't.

 Comfortable in a small, fast-moving team where processes are still being built.

 Nice-to-Haves 
 Experience with networking, security, or zero trust products.

 Experience with open source projects or developer communities.

 Experience building CLI products.

 Hands-on experience with self-hosting, Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud infrastructure.

 Some coding experience, enough to read a PR or reproduce a bug yourself.

 Experience using product analytics to back up decisions.
 

 😌 What’s in it for you 
 We want you to do meaningful work and be proud of what you build.
 That’s why we offer:
 Comprehensive compensation package : Receive a competitive base salary and equity incentives.

 Hybrid work environment : Enjoy the flexibility of working both from our centrally located Berli

jobs.description:
🌟 Position: Risk Manager – Major Infrastructure Project

 We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Risk Manager to join our Project Controls team and play a key role supporting one of the UK’s largest and most complex infrastructure programmes.
 Working as part of a major capital delivery environment, you will be responsible for supporting the effective identification, assessment and management of project risks across a complex programme of work. You will work closely with Project Controls, Planning, Commercial, Cost and Project Management teams to provide robust risk insight and help ensure that project decisions are informed by a clear understanding of uncertainty and exposure.

The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain. 

 As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business. 

 As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem. 
 You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities. 
 You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems. 
 You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability. 
 You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly. 
 You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption.

 Skills Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus). 
 Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics. 
 Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools.

 Business fluency in both  English and German  is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff.

 Warum gibt es diese Stelle? PIABO entwickelt eine eigene Softwareplattform, die internes Wissen und Abläufe für die Teams nutzbar macht. Erste Anwendungen sind bereits im Einsatz. Unser Anspruch ist, daraus ein verlässliches Produktportfolio zu entwickeln: Lösungen, die im Arbeitsalltag genutzt werden, einen nachvollziehbaren Nutzen stiften und sich bei belegter Wirkung für weitere Teams, Kundenprojekte oder neue Angebote eignen.

Damit diese Entwicklung gelingt, braucht es klare Entscheidungen darüber, welche Probleme Priorität haben und welche Lösungen verlässlich in den Einsatz kommen. Die Rolle verbindet Produkt- und Technologieentwicklung, gibt dem bestehenden fünfköpfigen Team aus Development und Project Management eine gemeinsame Richtung und verantwortet zugleich PIABOs operative IT- und Tool-Landschaft.

 Drei Must-haves für die Stelle Produkt- und Business-Urteil:  Du verbindest Produktentscheidungen mit konkretem Geschäftsnutzen.
 Hands-on Engineering: Du bringst eigene Entwicklungserfahrung mit und beurteilst technische Qualität praktisch.
 Führung und operative Verantwortung:  Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Führung und einen verlässlichen IT-Betrieb.
 

 Was du bei uns tust und wie Portfolio und Priorisierung: Du berätst die Geschäftsführung zu Produkt- und Technologieentscheidungen. Du bewertest Vorhaben nach Geschäftswirkung, Machbarkeit, Risiken und Kapazität und übersetzt priorisierte Themen in realistische Umsetzungsetappen. Wenn Nutzen oder Voraussetzungen nicht tragen, machst du das transparent und empfiehlst Alternativen.
 Use Cases und Erfolgskriterien:  Gemeinsam mit den nutzenden Teams nimmst du konkrete Abläufe und Probleme auf, grenzt den Bedarf ein und legst fest, welchen Nutzen die Lösung schaffen soll und woran erfolgreiche Nutzung erkennbar wird.
 Software entwickeln:  Du baust selbst Prototypen und produktive Software mit AI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen, darunter Coding Agents und LLM-APIs. Du testest Annahmen früh und führst tragfähige Lösungen in den produktiven Einsatz.
 Technische Qualität sichern: Du verantwortest technische Konzepte und Qualitätsmaßstäbe: von Architektur, APIs, Datenflüssen und Integrationen bis zu Tests, Code-Reviews, Dokumentation und Übergabe in den Betrieb.
 Team führen und entwickeln:  Du führst das fünfköpfige Team aus Development und Project Management disziplinarisch. Du setzt gemeinsame Prioritäten und Qualitätsmaßstäbe, gibst Feedback und entwickelst Zusammenarbeit und fachliche Stärke weiter.
 Einführung und Wirkung nachhalten:  Du begleitest die Einführung in den nutzenden Teams und prüfst anhand der vereinbarten Erfolgssignale und Rückmeldungen, ob die Lösung im Alltag genutzt wird und den erwarteten Nutzen liefert. Daraus leitest du ab, was weiterentwickelt, skaliert oder beendet wird.
 Operative IT verantworten:  Du verantwortest PIABOs operative IT- und Tool-Landschaft und koordinierst die zuständigen internen und externen Spezialist:innen. Du hältst Zuständigkeiten für verlässlichen Betrieb, Zugriffe, Security und Datenschutz klar und sorgst dafür, dass Fragen mit der nötigen Expertise bearbeitet werden.
 

 Das bringst du mit Die folgenden Erfahrungen sind für die Rolle erforderlich; unterschiedliche Karrierewege können passen: Du bringst mindestens zehn Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Software- und Produktentwicklung sowie mehrere Jahre eigene Entwicklungspraxis mit – zum Beispiel mit Node.js/TypeScript, Python oder Go. Du hast produktive Systeme selbst gebaut und betrieben.

 Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (C1) und sehr gut Englisch (B2).

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Role description As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.
 
 You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track.  
 
 This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on. 

 Your Mission Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
 Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success  
 Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead. 
 Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees. 
 Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables. 
 Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods. 
 

 Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
 Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure. 
 Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments. 
 Strong analytical and problem solving skills. 
 Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress. 
 Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit. 
 Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1). 
 Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking. 
 

 Preferred Qualifications Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.
 IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus. 
 Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment. 
 Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats. 
 Experience with Jira and Confluence. 
 Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation. 
 

 Why you'll love working here Exciting tasks in an internationally operating, growing family business with flat hierarchies
 Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model
 4 weeks remote work from other EU countries
 30 days paid vacation per year
 Salary bands for a fair corporate culture
 Monthly allowance of €50 for your BAV
 Annual 360° feedback loops with clear promotion criteria and an individual career path
 Responsibility from day one in a company that encourages personal responsibility and growth
 Relocation costs can be reimbursed on a pro rata basis
 Regular company events such as summer party, Christmas party
 Paid team dinners or activities for each team twice a year
 Free parking right outside the door
 Perks and benefits: JobRad, subsidized lunch, subsidy for the Deutschlandticket, free language courses and discounted memberships at several gyms and for the Wellpass
 Fresh fruit, free drinks and snacks in the office

 Ensure local execution of global study plans in alignment with timelines and quality standards.
 Serve as the key point of contact for local investigational sites and regional stakeholders.
 
 2. Regulatory & Compliance Oversight 
 Ensure that clinical trial activities comply with local regulations, ICH‑GCP, and internal SOPs.
 Coordinate local submissions to competent authorities and ethics committees when required.
 Monitor adherence to regulatory timelines and manage any corrective actions.
 
 3. Site & Vendor Coordination 
 Support site selection, activation, monitoring, and close‑out in collaboration with CRAs and vendors.
 Manage relationships with local vendors (logistics, labs, CRO partners).
 Follow up on recruitment progress, performance, and site‑level metrics.
 
 4. Cross‑Functional Collaboration 
 Work closely with global study teams, medical affairs, regulatory affairs, and clinical operations.
 Participate in study meetings and provide updates on local activities, challenges, and achievements.
 Support risk mitigation plans and operational troubleshooting.
 
 5. Data Quality & Operational Tracking 
 Oversee data accuracy, query resolution, and compliance of documentation.
 Track KPIs, patient recruitment, timelines, and operational deliverables.
 Contribute to audit and inspection readiness.
 
 Requirements 
 Experienced in Clinical Operations within pharma or CRO. 
 Experience as Clinical Project Manager, Study Manager, or equivalent .
 Previous involvement in interventional trials (Phase II–IV preferred).
 Solid understanding of ICH‑GCP, regulatory environment, and local clinical research practices.
 Experience collaborating with investigators, CROs, and cross‑functional teammates.
 Strong organizational, operational, and communication skills.
 Ability to manage several tasks simultaneously in a fast‑paced environment.
 Fluency in French and English (written & spoken).

jobs.title: Self-Serve Product Manager - ElevenCreative
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
 ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
 
 How we work
 High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 
 What we offer
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

 About the role
 We're hiring a Self-Serve PM to own the core ElevenCreative product experience for creators and marketers who sign up, subscribe, and build on their own. Self-serve users make up the majority of ElevenCreative's user base, and they use the platform to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
 You'll own self-serve revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That includes how users discover what ElevenCreative can do, how they move from a first generation into agents, video, and multi-step creative workflows, and what keeps them coming back and upgrading. There's no shortage of things we could build. The job is defining the big bets, scoping them well, and shipping them quickly with the team.
 PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward growth or go-to-market work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for its users.
 
 What you'll do
 Own self-serve revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, onboarding, lifecycle, and go-to-market levers to drive results

 Scope and define the big bets for the self-serve product across image, video, music, agents, and editing workflows

 Find the biggest opportunities in the user journey through product data and user behavior, and turn them into clearly scoped projects

 Drive adoption of newer experiences like agents and video, helping users expand from a single product into the full platform

 Work with engineering and design to ship quickly, mocking up early concepts yourself when it speeds things up

 Partner with growth, lifecycle, and social teams on launches and the moments that bring users into new parts of the product

 Define success metrics for your area and track activation, engagement, retention, and conversion to paid plans

 Talk to creators and marketers regularly to understand how they work and where the product falls short, and bring those insights back to the team

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager (Project Developers)
jobs.description:
About Us 
 At Gridcog, we’re on a mission to accelerate investment in the clean energy transition. We are a SaaS start-up of energy nerds building the best project modelling software, so our users can make intelligent energy decisions.
 Who we’re looking for
 Our software enables professionals in renewable energy to make informed investments into energy projects that deliver economic and environmental value. Our clients include many of the world’s leading Developers, IPPs, Consultants and Energy Majors. We already have a strong presence with a small team in Berlin and a number of clients in the German market including Octopus Energy Generation, Shell, Suncatcher, Meteocontrol, Greenvolt, MaxSolar and Hep Energy.
 As our first business development team member in Berlin, you will help grow our presence with Project Developers in Germany, at both utility (front-of-the-meter) and distribution (behind-the-meter) scale. Gridcog is experiencing strong growth in this client sector, driven by increasing project complexity, due to co-location, flexible connection agreements, data center development and important regulatory changes that require advanced modelling software including MiSpeL and AgNes.
 You will be able to quickly build rapport with our clients and prospects, empathise with their challenges (modelling complex energy projects) and demonstrate how Gridcog’s software solution will help. You will own new business growth targets for Gridcog in Germany and Central Europe, delivering on a pre-agreed quarterly sales target.
 You’ll also have a passion for the Gridcog mission, be a self-starter who is happy to work at pace in a fast growing startup, and enjoy collaborating with your colleagues globally. If this sounds like you, please read on!

 What you’ll do as part of our team
 Contribute to Gridcog’s growth by winning new Project Developer accounts in Germany and Central Europe, in line with agreed company and individual targets. This includes managing and qualifying a pipeline of opportunities, targeting specific client accounts, managing client demo processes and closing opportunities.
 Develop a strong understanding of the renewable energy project financing lifecycle in Germany and across Central Europe, positioning yourself to support leading companies in expanding their asset portfolios.
 Share customer and market insights with the wider Gridcog team.
 Build your personal brand in the German energy industry by attending events and supporting Gridcog marketing activity.
 Follow and improve our commercial processes including keeping your pipeline and deal records up to date in our CRM.
 Act as part of a global team, supporting your colleagues in pursuit of company-wide goals.
 Learn from and contribute to a small but experienced and successful business development team, with exposure to complex deals and decision making.
 
 Requirements 
 To be successful in this role you will have
 Demonstrated success in a senior commercial role in energy. This could be in data, research or SaaS sales, or a background in power markets gained through experience in origination, project development or analytics.
 A strong network in the German energy ecosystem, particularly with Developers and IPPs.
 A good understanding of battery storage in the German market.
 Demonstrable success in both hitting and exceeding objective targets.
 Ambition, energy and commercial drive. You’ll be a self-starter, comfortable in ambiguity and willing to get stuck in – Gridcog is a dynamic startup environment.
 Exceptional communication skills in German and English, with a strong sense of customer empathy; you build strong and enduring relationships with your clients and with your colleagues in London, Madrid, Melbourne and Perth.
 A willingness to become an expert in the Gridcog software.

 We’d also love it if you have
 Familiarity with Flexible Connection Agreements, EEG, MiSpeL and AgNes.
 Technical knowledge in more than one of the following areas: renewable energy, battery storage or wholesale energy markets.
 Knowledge of the energy project financing cycle including project bankability and debt financing.
 Demonstrated success in a B2B SaaS business.
 Experience using different sales methodologies.
 Startup experience.
 Fluency in another European language.

 Competitive remuneration package aligned with experience and skills.

 Support for ongoing professional and personal development.

jobs.title: (Senior) Consultant & Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle
 Du berätst unsere Kunden dabei, was ein Projekt erreichen soll, und verantwortest, dass es dort ankommt. Als (Senior) Consultant & Project Manager arbeitest du an Projekten und Produkten in Commerce, Daten und KI, vom ersten Workshop bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson des Kunden, führst die Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung und Partnern und übernimmst Product Ownership.
 Deine Aufgaben
 Beraten 
 Du klärst mit dem Kunden, was ein Projekt erreichen soll, und übersetzt seine Geschäftsziele in Produktentscheidungen.
 Du leitest Discovery-Workshops mit Fachbereichen und empfiehlst, was gebaut wird und was nicht.
 Nach dem Go-live prüfst du mit dem Kunden, ob das Projekt die Kennzahlen bewegt, für die es gestartet wurde.
 Steuern 
 Du planst und steuerst mehrere Projekte parallel und verantwortest Zeit, Budget und Qualität.
 Du übernimmst Product Ownership: Du priorisierst das Backlog und triffst Scope-Entscheidungen mit dem Kunden.
 Du sprichst Zielkonflikte früh an und führst Entscheidungen herbei.
 Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, UX und Daten-Teams zusammen und begleitest Releases, Go-lives und die Weiterentwicklung danach.
 Du nutzt KI in deiner eigenen Arbeit und entwickelst unsere Methoden weiter.
 Als Senior berätst du Kunden bis auf Führungsebene, führst größere oder strategische Projekte, bist fest in Angebote und Pitches eingebunden und unterstützt andere Kolleginnen und Kollegen mit deiner Erfahrung.
 Dein Profil
 Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Beratung, Projektmanagement oder Product Ownership bei technischen Digitalprojekten, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder Beratung.
 Erfahrung mit Projekten in Commerce, Daten oder KI. Erfahrung mit agentischen Lösungen ist ein Plus.
 Du denkst in Kennzahlen des Kunden und kannst Fachbereichen erklären, was eine technische Entscheidung für ihr Geschäft bedeutet.
 Du steuerst Budget und Scope sicher, auch wenn mehrere Projekte parallel laufen.
 Du arbeitest agil oder klassisch, je nachdem, was das Projekt braucht.
 Du sprichst mit Kunden auf Augenhöhe und sprichst Konflikte an, bevor sie teuer werden.
 Erfahrung mit Workshops auf Fachbereichs- oder Führungsebene ist ein Plus.
 Sehr gutes Deutsch (mindestens C1) und gutes Englisch.
 Was dich erwartet
 Projekte mit Händlern und Herstellern auf einem modernen Composable-Stack, mit Partnern wie commercetools, Snowflake und weiteren.
 Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege.
 Austausch mit anderen Consultants, Project Managern und Product Ownern im Team.
 Ein klarer Weg vom Project Manager zum Senior, mit der Möglichkeit, dich in Discovery, Pitches und Beratung einzubringen.
 Weiterbildung ist bei uns fest vorgesehen: Du schlägst Konferenzen, Kurse oder Zertifizierungen vor, und wir planen sie gemeinsam ein.
 KI-Werkzeuge und moderne Hardware als selbstverständlicher Teil der Arbeit.

 Key Responsibilities

 Coordination . Youâll manage cross-functional teams of 5â10 people and ensure tests move smoothly from idea â build â launch â analysis. Youâll spot risks early, unblock teams, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

 Strategy & Planning. Youâll help build and maintain a testing roadmap of 10â20 upcoming experiments. Youâll communicate the âwhyâ behind the plan, set expectations, and walk clients through progress and results in weekly meetings.

 Energy (âVibesâ). Youâre the main point of contact for clients and internal teams. You bring clarity, positivity, and momentum. When things get busy or complicated, you keep people focused and motivated.

 
 Skills, Knowledge and Traits

 You do not need prior A/B testing experience or even formal project management experience. We will train you. Hereâs what we need from you:

 
 Organization and diligence. You like systems, checklists, and timelines. You front-load work, plan ahead, and donât stop until things are finished properly.

 Communication. You default to over-communication. You proactively reach out to clients and teammates, flag risks early, and ask for help when you need it.

 Smart and high agency. You learn quickly, enjoy technology and design, and want to understand why things work (or donât. Youâre the kind of person who notices patterns and asks good questions.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely 
 Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.
 Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.
 Why this role? 
  
 As a Staff Product Manager in Snyk's Agent Security division, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how modern organizations build and secure AI applications at scale. You'll join a collaborative, forward-thinking team and help drive our mission to embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to shape early-stage products from the ground up, operating with the agility of a startup while leveraging the scale of an industry leader.
 
 What You’ll Do 
 Lead new product discovery from idea to execution by partnering with engineers, designers, and customers to identify high-potential opportunities in AI security and beyond.

 Validate problem-solution fit by designing lean experiments and MVPs to quickly validate customer problems and solution approaches.

 Shape the vision and roadmap for the capabilities that you own, balancing short-term experiments with long-term strategic bets.

 Influence the broader innovation agenda by presenting roadmap and strategy to customers, leadership, and internal stakeholders.

 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to take new ideas from concept to product-market fit.

 
 What You Bring 
 You have solid experience in technology, with strong experience in a product management role.

 You bring a strong technical background and the ability to engage deeply with engineering and AI/ML concepts.

 You are comfortable with high ambiguity and can design frameworks to execute effectively in fast-moving, uncertain environments.

 You have a proven track record of taking early-stage products from concept to launch within SaaS or developer tooling.

 You have strong communication and storytelling skills to influence across teams, leadership, and customers.

 
 It’d Be Awesome If You Also… 
 Have hands-on experience in developer security, AI/ML products, or agentic systems.

 Contribute to open-source or developer communities.

 Have a background in software engineering or have worked in a startup or internal incubator environment.

 Love solving complex problems with a collaborative team.

 Bring fresh ideas and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.

 About Snyk 
 Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity 
 Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. 
 You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. 

 Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence  
 Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. 

 Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. 

 Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. 

 Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 

 2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership  
 Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. 

 Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). 

 Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. 

 Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 

 3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement  
 Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. 

 Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. 

 Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. 

 What We Want to Achieve Together 
 In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. 
 In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. 

 Your profile Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. 

 Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. 

 Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. 

 Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. 

 AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. 

 A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. 

 Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. 

 

 Why us? Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else. 

 A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI. 

 Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites. 

 Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation. 

 Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority. 

 

 Process 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations. 

 Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live. 

 Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset. 

 Meet the team in the office. 

 Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team!

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager – Integrations & Connectors (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission
 Construction companies run their tenders across many tools. Your mission is to make Cosuno the place where it all comes together. Tenders should flow into Cosuno automatically from the systems our customers already use, and results should flow back out without anyone lifting a finger. The deeper Cosuno sits in our customers' processes, the more value we create for them.
 At the same time, AI assistants like Claude and Gemini are becoming how people work. You'll launch our first MCP server so that our customers can analyze their data and operate Cosuno straight from their AI assistant.
 

 How you'll get there: 
 Get to know our customers. Your first weeks are all about listening. You'll talk to customers and find out what it takes for our REST API and connectors to become part of their daily work. Together with Engineering, Customer Success and Sales, you'll turn those insights into a clear roadmap. You'll also set up the tracking that shows how much of our customers' work flows in through integrations.

 Launch the first API improvements and our first MCP server. You'll shape both, write the engineering tickets and roll them out to our first pilot customers, all within your first few months.

 Decide what comes next. Once real usage data and pilot feedback come in, you'll make clear recommendations on what to build and decide on the way forward together with our CTO and Head of Product.

 Make integrations the norm. By the end of your first year, far more of our customers will run Cosuno connected to the tools they rely on, and you'll be the one who made it happen.

 It's an ambitious plan, and that's what makes it fun: you'll see the impact of your work directly in our customers' day-to-day.
 
 How we work: 
 Full ownership: You own integrations end to end, from the first customer conversation to the shipped feature. Engineering takes care of the implementation.

 Close to the customer: You'll talk to customers constantly, mostly remotely, sometimes on-site across Germany.

 Technical by nature: You'll read API docs, test endpoints yourself and discuss data models with engineers. You don't write production code.

 AI-first: We use AI deeply in our product and in our daily work, and we expect you to do the same.
 

 What you bring: 
 You've shaped an API from the product side. You've defined, together with customers and engineering, what a public API or integration of a SaaS product exposes: endpoints, data models, auth, permissions.

 You're technical enough to go deep with engineers. Webhooks vs. polling, pagination, rate limits, OAuth: you can discuss trade-offs, and you test APIs yourself.

 You find the real need. You've worked directly with customers, separated what they ask for from what they really need, and found what it takes for them to use an integration.

 You write tickets engineers love. Clear scope, clear acceptance criteria, and a clear line on what's out of scope. You prioritize by impact, not by who shouts loudest.

 You're fast. You ship in weeks, not quarters, and you build, learn and iterate in parallel.

 You explain complex things simply , to a construction company's project manager as well as to internal stakeholders like our commercial teams or our management.

 You live AI. You use LLM assistants and MCPs every day, and you've built your own automations.

 You keep growing. You actively build your skills, and you seek and act on feedback.

 Fluent German and English. Our customers are German construction companies who work in German. Our engineering team works in English.

 Based in Germany and open to traveling to customers across the country.

 Bonus points if you've helped build an MCP server that customers use, or if you know construction tech, ERP or estimating systems (e.g. RIB iTWO, SAP, Nevaris).

 
 Why us?
 Real impact: You'll shape how an entire industry connects its software and how AI agents work with it.

 Competitive compensation: A salary above the market average.

 Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, with flexible working hours.

 Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

 A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events.

 Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

 Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations with our Head of Product.
 

 About us
 Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.
  
 We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.
 Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avo

jobs.title: Product Owner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Crewmeister ist die führende Lösung zur Zeiterfassung und Schichtplanung von kleinen Unternehmen. Mit unserer Software unterstützen wir über 20.000 Kunden, das Stundenzettel-Chaos zu überwinden. Die Basis für unseren Erfolg sind unsere mehr als 60 Mitarbeitenden, die mit Herzblut, Neugier, Analytik und einer Menge Grips unsere Kunden mit unserem Produkt noch erfolgreicher machen.

 Bewirb dich dich bei uns als Product Owner , lerne von den Besten und mache unsere Erfolgsgeschichte zu deiner Erfolgsgeschichte.

 Dein Verantwortungsbereich: 

 Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase wirst du immer mehr zu einem wichtigen Treiber unserer Produktvision. Das bedeutet für uns:

 
 Du bist neugierig und bestrebt, die Bedürfnisse und Herausforderungen unserer Kunden zu verstehen und verfolgst unermüdlich die bestmögliche Lösung für sie.

 Du arbeitest eng mit dem Entwicklungsteam zusammen, um Produktideen in die Realität umzusetzen. Dabei beginnst du mit dem Verstehen der Anforderungen und bietest kontinuierliche Unterstützung während der Implementierung. So stellst du sicher, dass unser Team ein klares und umfassendes Verständnis des Projekts und der Kundenbedürfnisse hat.

 Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den Erfolg des Produkts: Gemeinsam mit dem Team erstellst du User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien, priorisierst Aufgaben und pflegst den Backlog. Dabei achtest du darauf, dass das Team an den wirklich wichtigen Dingen arbeitet.

 Du triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen, um eine reibungslose Produktimplementierung sicherzustellen, und fungierst als wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen dem Produkt- und dem Entwicklungsteam.

 Du hältst dich stets über offene Fehlerberichte sowie die Herausforderungen der Kunden und Stakeholder auf dem Laufenden.

 Du arbeitest eng mit unserem aktuellen Product Owner und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um unsere Produkt-Roadmap zu verstehen und aktiv mitzugestalten.

 Du bist verantwortlich für die Releases unserer mobilen App(s).

 
 Erforderliche Qualifikationen:

 
 
 Du hast ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium oder Ähnliches.

 
 Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Softwareentwicklung.

 
 Du hast 3-4 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Projektmanagement- oder Produktorganisation-Rolle.

 
 Du hast Erfahrung im DACH-Markt.

 
 Du hast Erfahrung mit einem Software- oder SaaS-Produkt.

 
 Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen in einem kleinen Unternehmen gesammelt.

 
 Du hast eine unerschöpfliche Neugier auf Technologie und das Verständnis der Benutzerbedürfnisse und strebst ständig nach Verbesserungen.

 
 Du bist mit agilen Werten sowie der Kanban- und Scrum-Methodik vertraut.

 
 Du hast Erfahrung im Schreiben von User Stories und im Aufteilen von Epics in nützliche Einheiten.

 
 Du bist schnell auf den Beinen und hast eine analytische, datengetriebene Denkweise.

 
 Du bringst ausgezeichnete Organisationsfähigkeiten und ein gutes Auge für Details mit.

 
 Du hast starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und sprichst fließend Englisch.

 
 Du sprichst sicher Deutsch (Niveau C1), da du auch mit Kunden interagieren wirst.

 
 Echte Verantwortung & große Freiheiten, um zusammen mit unserem internationalen Team einen bedeutenden Unterschied zu bewirken.

 
 Home-Office-Flexibilität: Maximiere deine Performance indem du von dort aus arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist.

 
 Modernes Office im Werksviertel Start-Up Hub, mit hauseigenen Barista.

 
 Coole Teamaktivitäten und Events

 
 Benefits wie: Essensgutscheine, JobRad, Fitnessstudio-Rabatte, Freikarten, MacBook, vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket

 
 Bei uns erhältst du nicht nur die Sicherheit eines finanzstarken Konzerns, sondern auch die Unternehmenskultur und Aufstiegschancen eines Start-ups.

 Bei Crewmeister geht es nicht nur um den Job, sondern um dich und dein Potenzial, um einen wirklichen Unterschied zu machen. Zeig uns, wer du bist – überzeuge uns mit deinem Lebenslauf und später im persönlichen Gespräch.

 Wir freuen uns darauf, dich vielleicht schon ganz bald in unserer Crew willkommen zu heißen!

jobs.title: Product Manager, Growth (Staff/Principal-level)
jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 
 As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.
 Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.
 
 About the role 
 Synthesia ships more product, faster, than we ever have. AI has collapsed the cost of building which means the hard part is no longer making things, it’s making sure people actually adopt them. That’s the job of Growth, and we’re changing how we do it: instead of bolting Growth on after launch to optimise, we’re embedding a Growth PM into every core bet from day one, so how a product acquires, activates and scales is designed in from the first cycle.
 We’re hiring a Growth Product Manager to report to our VP of Growth. You'll own the Growth surface for one of those bets while helping build a growth-led way of working across the company.
 
 What you’ll be doing 
 Own Growth for a core product area end to end, acquisition, activation, adoption and retention, baked into the roadmap from the start, not retrofitted.

 Partner closely with the core product PMs and engineers who own the surface, bringing high-impact growth ideas and working out where they fit, and getting the primitives exposed that let you build and scale on top.

 Design growth into the product itself: discovery-led acquisition loops, and experiences that get users to their job-to-be-done in a couple of clicks (sometimes without opening the editor at all).

 Rally teams around specific, measurable outcomes and help each one hit its goal faster through what you build together.

 Work across engineering, marketing and GTM to make funnel- and journey-thinking a normal part of how we build.

 Who you are 
 AI-native. You’ve driven AI into how a product or team works - not just worked somewhere that does AI. You use it daily, you’re curious about how the stack works, and you keep up as it moves (fast).

 Scrappy and comfortable in ambiguity. You’ve taken something 0→1, you move fast, and you don’t need a clean brief or a stable roadmap to make progress. Constant change energises you rather than blocking you.

 A builder of credibility. You win trust across teams quickly and can get engineers, PMs and GTM aligned around growth - even when that’s a new way of working for them.

 Technically fluent and genuinely curious. You can hold your own with engineers on how things work and where the trade-offs are.

 Outcome-driven. You anchor on the right metric and move it.

 Requirements 
 Experience as a Product Manager with exposure to Growth. Depth in a single specific lever is a plus, not a prerequisite.

 Demonstrable experience driving AI-native product or ways of working.

 Comfortable in a fast-moving, 0→1, frequently-disrupted environment.

 Strong communication and the personality to build credibility and influence across functions.

 Technical fluency to partner credibly with engineering.

 Location
 Remote from Europe or hybrid based from our London or Munich offices. 
  
 Our culture
 At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here. 
  
 Global benefits:

 Work from home budget 

 Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year

 ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
 
 How we work
 High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 
 What we offer
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

 About the role
 We're hiring an Enterprise PM to own the product experience for businesses using ElevenCreative. ElevenCreative helps creators and marketers generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. A growing share of that usage comes from enterprise teams, including brands, agencies, studios, and media companies that roll it out across their organizations.
 You'll own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That covers the admin, permissioning, and governance features large organizations need to deploy ElevenCreative across teams, as well as the enterprise products we're building on top of the platform, like our Ads Engine. You'll work directly with sales and customers to understand what's blocking deals and adoption, scope and define the big bets, and ship them.
 PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward go-to-market or customer work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for enterprise teams.
 
 What you'll do
 Own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, packaging, go-to-market, and customer levers to drive results

 Scope and define the big bets for enterprise, from discovery through launch and adoption

 Build the admin and governance layer enterprises need, including role-based permissions, visibility into who has access to what, usage and spend controls, and reporting across teams

 Partner with engineering to scope and ship enterprise products like Ads Engine, turning complex customer workflows into products that scale beyond a single account

 Work with sales to triage feature requests and deal blockers, prioritize across them, and close the gap between what customers need and what we ship

 Join customer conversations to understand how enterprise teams evaluate, buy, and roll out creative tooling, and bring those insights back into the roadmap

 Define success metrics for enterprise features and track adoption, expansion, and retention across accounts

 Work closely with engineering, design, sales, and growth to ship quickly and drive projects all the way through

jobs.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus 
 Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. 
 Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. 

 Deine Rolle bei June 
 
 Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. 
 Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.  
 Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. 

 Anforderungen Was du mitbringst 
 Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. 

 Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich)  

 Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. 

 Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). 

 AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. 

 Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. 

 Das wäre ein Plus 
 Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.  

 Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. 

 

 Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst 
 Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. 

 Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. 

 Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. 

 Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. 

 Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. 

 Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. 

 Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. 

 So arbeiten wir 
 
 Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. 
 Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. 
 Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. 
 Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. 

 Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet 
 Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. 

 Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern 

 Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite. 

 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap. 

 Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege. 

 Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess. 

 Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten. 

 Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort. 

 Hinweis:  Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
 
 We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
 
 Here’s what this particular role covers.
 🛠️ About our Product Team 
 Our Product team works at the intersection of AI research, engineering and customer needs to shape the future of autonomous driving at Wayve. We define product direction, translate complex technical capabilities into clear roadmaps, and bring cross-functional teams together to turn research into products that deliver real-world impact.
 Working closely with engineers, researchers, programme managers and automotive partners, we balance long-term ambition with practical delivery. We combine technical depth with product judgement, listen carefully to our customers and teams, and create alignment around what to build, why it matters and how we’ll measure success.
 
 🧠 Your day-to-day 
 Lead a cross-functional team of engineers, researchers and PMs without formal authority. Give them clarity, remove blockers, and motivate them through hard, ambiguous problems.

 Engage deeply with technical detail across AI / ML, autonomy and embodied AI. Debate trade-offs credibly with senior researchers and engineers, and bring structured thinking to complex technical decisions.

 Communicate crisply across audiences, from deep technical reviews with engineers, to executive updates with leadership, to customer-facing conversations.

 Listen actively to engineers, partners and customers, and turn what you hear into better decisions and stronger team alignment.

 
 🧩 What you’ll be working on: 
 Independently own a substantial work package end-to-end. Define the problem, set the strategy, sequence the work, and lead the team to ship outcomes that move the AI Driver product forward.

 Translate R&D progress and customer needs into a clear product roadmap, sequencing capabilities to maximise impact and de-risk delivery.

 Set, track and report on clear KPIs and milestones, and establish the operating rhythm the team needs to deliver.

 
 🙌 You should apply if: 
 You’ve independently owned a substantial work package and led a cross-functional team to deliver it. You take responsibility for outcomes and proactively work through blockers.

 You bring strong technical depth, ideally in AI/ML, autonomy, robotics or another deep-tech domain, and can engage credibly with senior engineers and researchers.

 You’re a careful listener and clear communicator who can motivate and energise a team through ambiguity.

 You have a proven track record in product management, technical programme management or a similar role working on complex, cutting-edge technical products.

 You work autonomously, exercise sound judgement and are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, then adapting as you learn.

 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.
  
 More about Wayve: 
 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.
 Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Social Experience
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance 

 Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
 
Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.
 The team 
 Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
 We’re hiring a Product Manager with deep UX and interaction design expertise to build social experiences around investing and trading at Kraken.
 
You should be comfortable designing flows yourself, building interactive prototypes, and working through interaction details with designers and engineers. You’ll also own the product decisions: which customer problem to solve, what to ship first, and how to measure whether the experience improved.
  
 The opportunity 
 Design complete social journeys. Work through how someone discovers a person, decides to follow them, shares an idea or trade, receives a response, and returns. Connect these interactions into an experience users understand without explanation.

 Make the interaction details work. Shape navigation, information hierarchy, copy, defaults, gestures, and feedback. Specify what happens when a feed is empty, a post fails, content loads slowly, or someone changes their mind.

 Prototype before committing to a build. Turn ideas into interactive prototypes that communicate the intended behavior. Explore alternatives, test the uncertain parts, and give engineering clear flows, states, and acceptance criteria.

 Use psychology to improve participation. Understand why people hesitate to post, seek recognition, follow strangers, or respond to others. Translate those motivations into decisions about audience visibility, prompts, reputation, feedback, and the effort required to contribute.

 Observe users and fix what gets in their way. Run usability sessions, watch people complete tasks, and combine those observations with funnel data. Identify where people misunderstand the product, lose confidence, or abandon an action.

 Design for first use and repeated use. Make the experience useful before someone has connections. Keep sharing lightweight during an active trading session, with clear control over what becomes public. Test the twentieth interaction as carefully as the first.

 Connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. For each significant change, define the expected behavior and how to test it. Track task completion, abandonment, first follows, first contributions, responses, and subsequent retention. Work with data science to evaluate experiments and effects on both contributors and their audiences.

 Take the experience through launch. Choose a focused initial scope, resolve trade-offs with engineering, review the implementation against the intended design, and use post-launch evidence to decide what to improve next.

  
 What you bring 
 Has designed and shipped consumer social experiences. Your portfolio shows your contribution to feeds, profiles, sharing, messaging, discovery, or communities—and how the experience changed after launch.

 Has strong interaction design craft. You can explain why a flow is structured a particular way, what users will notice first, what they need to understand, and which decisions or steps can be removed.

 Can build realistic interactive prototypes. You use Figma, code, AI tools, or a combination to make behavior tangible and testable, including transitions, empty states, and failure states.

 Understands behavior through evidence. You can show where user research challenged your assumptions and changed a design.

 Can own product outcomes. You can prioritize a problem, define success, interpret funnel and cohort data, and explain whether an experiment produced a meaningful improvement.

 Understands the context of social finance. You account for how credibility, incentives, reputation, and visibility of financial activity affect what people trust and choose to share.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Technical
jobs.description:
About Wheely

Wheely is redefining premium transportation across major cities in Europe, the US, and the Middle East. We blend cutting-edge technology with the craft of five-star chauffeuring to deliver an experience trusted by more than 100,000 active riders and 1,200 corporate accounts.

We’re a profitable, fast-growing scale-up with $43M raised and over $100M in annual revenue. Having recently launched in New York City, we’re expanding rapidly across the US and EMEA. If you take pride in your craft and want to help shape the next chapter of our growth, we'd love to hear from you.

About The Role

As a Product Manager, you will have sole responsibility over the roadmap of one of our technical products (mapping, marketplace, billing, privacy, etc). You’ll play a pivotal role in shaping its future, working directly with our founder.

Responsibilities

  • Lead a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and data scientists
  • Set your team’s goals and roadmap to align with Wheely’s mission
  • Own your team’s products (existing and new) across from idea, through development, to launch, growth and maintenance
  • Collaborate with other product squads and other stakeholders

Requirements

  • 2+ years of proven success working on technical products (platforms, distributed systems, machine learning, mapping, etc.)
  • STEM degree or previous experience as an engineer
  • Outstanding written communication, with a talent for maintaining accurate feature specifications as the single source of truth
  • Highly analytical, with the ability to pull your own numbers and conduct your own analysis

What we offer

  • Office-based role in West London, four days a week with flexible start and finish times, plus one remote day of your choice
  • Salary: £90000–£110000 annual (subject to experience) 
  • Employee stock options plan
  • Private medical and dental insurance
  • Life and critical illness cover
  • Latest-generation MacBook Pro and 4k display
  • Monthly credit towards Wheely journeys
  • Cycle to Work scheme

You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1.
