jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Quantum Research
jobs.description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions 
 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager – Advanced Technology Programs to lead large-scale, strategic technology and R&D programs involving multiple technical disciplines, internal teams and external partners.
 You will operate at the intersection of technology, engineering and program execution , turning ambitious technical objectives into structured and executable programs.
 You will coordinate programs involving disciplines such as quantum physics, integrated photonics, semiconductor technologies, electronics, optics, hardware engineering, software and algorithms , while ensuring alignment between technical performance, schedule, resources, budget and contractual commitments.
 We are particularly interested in candidates who have managed large and technically complex programs in demanding engineering environments such as space, aerospace, defense or semiconductors , where successful delivery requires coordinating multidisciplinary teams, suppliers, industrial partners, research organizations and institutional stakeholders across several countries.
 This is a senior individual contributor / program leadership position requiring both technical credibility and strong execution capabilities . You will not be expected to be the scientific expert on every topic, but you must be able to understand complex technical dependencies, challenge assumptions, structure decisions and create the conditions for engineering teams to deliver.
 
 Key responsabilities 
 
 ** Lead Complex Technology Projects 
 Take end-to-end ownership of strategic R&D and technology projects, from initial framing through development, integration, validation and final delivery.
 Translate high-level scientific, product or business ambitions into clear program objectives, work packages, milestones, interfaces and measurable deliverables .
 Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, resources, budget, dependencies and critical paths.
 Establish program governance and ensure effective decision-making across technical teams and senior stakeholders.
 Monitor progress against milestones and proactively identify deviations, bottlenecks and dependencies requiring management attention.
 Drive recovery plans when projects deviate from their original objectives, including prioritization, resource reallocation, scope adjustment or technical replanning.
 
 ** Manage Technical complexity & interfaces 
 Coordinate multidisciplinary teams spanning quantum physics, photonics, semiconductor technologies, optics, electronics, mechanical engineering, systems engineering, software and algorithms .
 Work closely with technical leads to identify critical interfaces and dependencies between subsystems and workstreams.
 Challenge project assumptions and ensure that technical decisions are translated into clear consequences for performance, schedule, cost and risk .
 Support the transition from research and scientific proof-of-concept to engineering development, prototyping, integration, qualification and demonstrators .
 Ensure that technical maturity, integration readiness and project risks are visible and understood at program level.
 
 * * Coordinate Internal & External Stakeholders 
 Act as a central coordination point between Quandela teams, industrial partners, suppliers, research institutions and institutional stakeholders.
 Lead technical and programmatic exchanges involving stakeholders with different scientific, engineering and business perspectives.
 Coordinate activities across multiple teams, organizations, sites and countries , ensuring clear ownership and effective information flow.
 Manage expectations and commitments with external partners while protecting Quandela's technical, contractual and strategic interests.
 Prepare and lead program reviews, steering committees and executive-level project updates.
 
 ** Risk, Budget & Delivery Management 
 Establish and maintain structured risk and opportunity management , including technical, schedule, supply-chain, financial and organizational risks.
 Own or contribute to program budgets, resource forecasts and capacity plan

jobs.description:
About DataCamp 

 DataCamp's mission is to empower everyone with the data and AI skills essential for 21st-century success. By providing practical, engaging learning experiences, DataCamp equips learners and organizations of all sizes to harness the power of data and AI. As a trusted partner to over 20 million learners and 6,000+ companies , including 80% of the Fortune 1000, DataCamp is leading the charge in addressing the critical data and AI skills shortage. About you 

 About the role 

 DataCamp is seeking a dynamic Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our team! In this pivotal role, you will support the creation and execution of our product marketing strategy. Collaborating with our commercial and product teams, you will craft compelling messaging highlighting DataCamp's unique value proposition to professional learners and organizations. Exceptional storytelling and communication skills are essential, alongside a proven ability to lead go-to-market campaign initiatives and deliver measurable results.

 This role is perfect for proactive problem-solvers who thrive in a hands-on, fast-paced environment. You'll need a sense of urgency, a revenue-driven mindset, and the ability to collaborate with diverse team members, including sales, customer success, product management, and content development teams. Initially, you'll focus on enhancing our messaging and collateral for prospects and existing customers, making this role ideal for candidates with a deep understanding of the data landscape and a passion for developing impactful product marketing initiatives from the ground up.

 About you: 

 At DataCamp, we seek individuals who embody our core values of data-driven action, transparency, ownership, and customer focus. We are seeking individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, high-performing sales organisation and are driven by a passion for democratising adoption of data & AI. Your entrepreneurial and collaborative spirit pushes you beyond just meeting/exceeding retention and expansion targets. You aim to understand the strategic imperatives at DataCamp's clients and strive to be a thought partner in transforming their data & AI readiness. You are a collaborative team player who is equally happy to work internally with sales, product, support, marketing as you are happy to roll up your sleeves and strategize with clients. You subscribe to the belief that people, process, technology, and data are all key ingredients to digitally transforming a business and you are energised by helping our clients up-level their data readiness at scale. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!

 Responsibilities 

 
 Lead B2B marketing campaigns: Drive go-to-market rollouts in collaboration with commercial teams, focusing on curriculum, product positioning, and creative initiatives.

 Craft compelling messaging: Develop and refine customer-centric positioning that highlights DataCamp's differentiation.

 Create impactful collateral: Produce sales and marketing materials to support the buyer's journey, including pitch decks, blogs, webinars, and case studies.

 Leverage customer insights: Collaborate with revenue and customer success teams to gather testimonials and refine messaging based on customer feedback.

 Manage analyst relations: Build relationships with analysts and communicate product capabilities and roadmap.

 Conduct competitive analysis: Track market trends and competitor strategies to identify opportunities and threats.

 
 Qualifications 

 
 5+ years of B2B product marketing experience in a data/AI SaaS company 

 Proven track record in the data or AI space , with deep understanding of industry trends and competitive landscape.

 Demonstrated success in leading and executing go-to-market strategies, with measurable impact on revenue, adoption, or market share.

 Exceptional English writing and presentation skills, with a portfolio showcasing compelling messaging, content, and thought leadership.

 Ability to excel in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with a high workload. Comfortable operating independently when needed.

 
 Why Datacamp? 

 Joining DataCamp means becoming part of a dynamic, creative, and international start-up. Here are just a few of the reasons why you'll love being on our team:

 
 Exciting challenges: Face new technical challenges daily, keeping your work engaging and rewarding.

 Collaboration Act as the main source of product context and the product's champion, making sure the team, leadership and customers understand what we're building and why.

 5+ years of product management experience with hardware–software products, for example in embedded systems, IoT, robotics, defence systems or edge AI.

 Experience running product development end to end, from discovery to engineering-ready work, and the ability to adapt to however a team works.

 Clear communication with hardware engineers, ML researchers and operators alike.

jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 Location 
 This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.
 Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.
 
 Your Mission 
 You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.
 As a Senior Project Manager , you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.
 At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.
 You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.
 We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.
 
 Your Career Path in Project Management 
 This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.
 Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management. 

 Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs. 

 Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

 Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

 Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

 Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

 Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

 Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

 Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

 Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

 In addition, as a Senior Project Manager 
 Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

 Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. jobs.title: Product Owner (m/w/d)
jobs.company: Mittwald CM Service GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Schaust du in den Spiegel und siehst das lebende Beispiel für gute Kommunikation, Konzeption und lösungsorientiertes Denken? Dann bist du hier richtig - erst recht, wenn du in der IT-Welt zu Hause bist und dich mit Web-Technologien auskennst. In der nächsten Zeit wollen wir ein neues Entwicklerteam aufbauen – und du könntest eine Schlüsselrolle darin spielen. Wenn du Bock hast, mit uns gemeinsam die Agenturwelt mit innovativen digitalen Produkten zu begeistern, melde dich!
 
 Das erwartet dich: 
 Die Sammlung und Priorisierung von Anforderungen sowie die Definition von Lösungskonzepten mit deinem Team

 Du trägst die Verantwortung für die Erstellung und Pflege des Product Backlogs

 Du koordinierst den Entwicklungsprozess und steuerst die Umsetzung der Anforderungen 

 Während des gesamten Prozesses begleitest und unterstützt du dein Entwicklungsteam 

 Märkte und relevante Wettbewerber hast du stets im Blick und verstehst, was unsere Kunden wirklich brauchen und was sie zukünftig begeistert

 Als Schnittstelle zwischen unseren verschiedenen Teams bist du der erste Ansprechpartner bei Fragen und gibst regelmäßig Updates zum derzeitigen Projektstatus

 
 Das bieten wir dir:
 Sicherheit & Perspektive 
 Wir arbeiten mit zukunftsweisenden Technologien und bauen Systeme, wenn nötig, lieber selbst, statt auf Fertiglösungen zu setzen. Das bringt Herausforderungen und ein technisches Niveau, das nicht alltäglich ist und dich fachlich weiterbringt.
 
 Geek paradise 
 Egal ob Kubernetes, Microservices oder React - bei uns kannst du das richtig nice Zeug machen. Damit du dein Bestes geben kannst, bist du der Admin auf deinem Gerät und hast die freie Wahl bei deiner Hardware und der Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes.
 Aktiver Teil der Community

Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that's just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we're transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences. You'll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You'll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you'll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we're building. If you're motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you'll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It's impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

The Guest Revenue tribe owns the products that help hotels earn more from every guest interaction: our booking engine, upselling tools, ancillary revenue features, and the guest recognition layer that makes personalization possible. You'll sit directly alongside Diana Arizmendi (Director of Product and Engineering) as her right hand on the tribe's hardest product problems: improving upsell attach rates (currently ~2%), scaling guest recognition, and shipping the Reputation Manager into GA. You won't be running discovery yourself for every feature — instead, you'll own the tribe's product context and encode your product judgment into the agents, evals, and shared systems that the Product Builders draw on autonomously. When the system doesn't produce the right output, you fix it at the root. When the tribe faces a genuinely ambiguous strategic bet, you own the answer.

What you would do

  • Own the product context your team builds from: the customer evidence, outcome definitions, prioritisation logic and decision history that makes every build decision faster and more grounded.
  • Encode your product thinking into shared tools and systems so that good problem framing and rigorous discovery happen by default, not through constant oversight.
  • Lead discovery on the team's hardest open questions, from improving how guests discover and accept offers to building the data layer that makes guest recognition reliable at scale.
  • Partner closely with the Director of Product and Engineering on complex strategic calls, cross functional alignment and the decisions that have the most long term leverage.
  • Collaborate with Staff Engineers and Staff Designers to make sure product decisions hold up technically and create experiences guests actually notice.

AI Fluency Level 3: in this role, that means you design the agents and shared workflows your product builders use to turn customer evidence into decisions, not just use AI tools yourself. You build an approach to discovery and context management that others on the team can pick up and run with on their own, and you are the one who checks whether an AI generated recommendation actually holds up before it shapes a commercial decision.

jobs.title: Head of Product Cost Optimization (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
About The Company

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with a wide range of design options, automated offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company is able to create resilient timber housing quickly and cost-effectively. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, strengthen Europe’s innovation capacity, and play a substantial role in improving sustainability. The company delivers its multi-family houses as a complete and turnkey solution. The combination of technology, construction, robotics, and manufacturing expertise means buildings can be created in a fully digitalized end-to-end process. The building system is based on versatile wall and slab elements, making it easier to optimize land use, customize plans, and build fast with both off-site construction and on-site assembly. This system is complemented by the Building Operating System–developed in-house.

Über die Position 

Werde Teil von GROPYUS und übernimm die Führung beim Aufbau einer erstklassigen Cost-Optimization-Funktion für unsere Gebäudesysteme. An der Schnittstelle von Produktentwicklung, Engineering, Fertigung, Einkauf und Bauausführung gestaltest du die Kostenwettbewerbsfähigkeit unserer Produkte über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg. 

Als Head of Cost Optimization / Building Systems definierst du Strategie, Methoden und Governance für die Kostenoptimierung unseres Produktportfolios. Du schaffst ein datenbasiertes Verständnis der Kostentreiber, identifizierst Potenziale zur Wertsteigerung und stellst sicher, dass Kostenaspekte von der ersten Konzeptphase bis zur industrialisierten Umsetzung in sämtliche Produkt- und Systementscheidungen integriert werden. 

Diese strategische Führungsrolle richtet sich an eine Persönlichkeit, die fundierte Expertise im Kostenmanagement mit ausgeprägtem technischem, industriellem und kaufmännischem Verständnis verbindet. Du baust die Cost-Optimization-Funktion auf und weiter aus, hinterfragst bestehende Annahmen und gestaltest aktiv die Weiterentwicklung der Gebäudesysteme von GROPYUS. 

Dein Aufgabenbereich umfasst: 

  • Definition und Führung der Cost-Optimization-Strategie für den Bereich Building Systems, um Kostenwettbewerbsfähigkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Wertschöpfung über das gesamte Produktportfolio hinweg sicherzustellen 
  • Gemeinsame Entwicklung und Implementierung von Design-to-Cost-, Should-Costing-, Value-Engineering- und Target-Costing-Methoden in den Bereichen Produktentwicklung, Fertigung, Einkauf und Bauausführung 
  • Systematische Identifikation, Bewertung und Priorisierung von Kostenoptimierungspotenzialen für Gebäudesysteme, Komponenten, Materialien und Schnittstellen 
  • Aufbau transparenter Kostenmodelle und Feedbackschleifen, um kontinuierliches Lernen aus geplanten und tatsächlich realisierten Kosten zu ermöglichen </

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are
 Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.
 Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.
 For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.
 Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.
 We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.
 Today, Lemrock is already:
 100M+ conversations per month

 150+ brand clients

 a $100B market structuring at high speed

 The role
 Product at Lemrock has been driven by the founders so far. As our first Product Manager , you'll work directly with the founders and our CTO to shape the product vision, own a core part of the product end to end, and build the practice that takes us from idea to shipped.
 You'll start by owning the brand-facing product , and your scope will grow fast from there.
 Your mission
 Shape the vision : bring your own conviction to the product strategy with the founders, from what we bet on next to what we stop doing.

 Own the roadmap end to end : turn strategy into a living, prioritized roadmap, and decide what we don't build so the team stays on the highest-impact work.

 Run discovery : spend real time with brands, partners and the field, find the problems worth solving, and validate before we build.

 Ship with the team : work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design to scope, prototype, and ship weekly, not quarterly.

 Own launches and outcomes : drive rollout, watch the data, onboard the business teams, and judge your work by what it moved, not by what shipped.

 Build the product function itself : the rituals, the prioritization, the feedback loop from the field.

 3 to 8 years in product , at least part of it at a startup or scale-up, ideally as an early or first PM. You've taken something from a vague problem to a shipped, used feature, and owned its results.

jobs.description:
About Gladia 
 Gladia builds the audio AI infrastructure behind the new generation of voice products. Our mission is to give every voice platform true conversational intelligence — the audio infrastructure that understands every conversation, turning voice into the world's most valuable data layer. 
 Our API turns real-world conversational audio into accurate, structured, real-time output — powered by our proprietary Solaria ASR , across 100+ languages, with industry-leading latency.
 Hundreds of companies build their voice products on Gladia — from meeting assistants and voice agents to sales-enablement and contact-center platforms. We started in Paris, our growth is developer-led and heavily US-driven (and we're going after the US market hard).
 Headquartered in vibrant tech hubs like Paris and New York City, Gladia has been by OVH Groupe — Europe's leading cloud provider — and now operates as a fully autonomous brand and company within the Group. 
 
 We're guided by four values :
 Honest — Say the real thing, kindly.

 Smart — Work smart, ship fast.

 Builders — Own your scope, build to last.

 Caring — Support people, take pride in the craft.

 The role 
 Gladia sells to very different buyers — from developers at AI startups to product and engineering leaders at large voice platforms such as contact centers . We need one clear, sharp story for each of them, and the tools that help our sales team tell it.
 And our portfolio is growing . Since joining OVH Groupe, we're expanding our product offering which means more products to position and new product lines to bring to market. We need an experienced Product Marketing Manager to help us position each of them and launch them successfully.
 As our first Product Marketing Manager , you'll own how Gladia is positioned and how we win. You'll define our messaging by segment, equip our sales team with what they need to close, orchestrate our product launches, and build a real understanding of our market, competitors, and buyers.
 You'll report to our Marketing Lead, with a strong dotted line to Product, and you'll work hand in hand with our Sales team: you'll be close to what we build and why, and you'll bring the voice of the market back into product decisions.  Positioning & messaging — Define Gladia's positioning and messaging for each customer segment, and keep it consistent across sales, marketing, and product

 Experience launching new product lines and overseeing GTM launches end-to-end, based on a clear playbook

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - F/H
jobs.description:
Le Product Management, c'est notre ADN.

 
 Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs produits digitaux et de leurs organisations. Ton rôle est d'allier vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle pour délivrer de la valeur tangible dans des environnements complexes.

 
 Ce que tu fais concrètement : 
 Tu prends la main sur un périmètre produit à fort enjeu business. Tu analyses les processus en place, tu identifies les leviers d'amélioration réels et tu formalises une vision produit et une feuille de route alignées sur les priorités métier.

 Tu décides avec la donnée. Tu mesures l'effet de tes arbitrages sur l'usage et la performance commerciale, tu construis les indicateurs qui manquent, et tu transformes une analyse en recommandation argumentée. Pas en tableau de bord de plus.

 Tu traduis le besoin métier en produit. Exigences fonctionnelles, user stories, critères d'acceptation, priorisation que tu assumes et que tu sais défendre.

 Tu interviens sur le socle SI. Tu contribues au cadrage et à l'évolution des briques applicatives concernées, en gardant la main sur le pourquoi quand tout le monde discute du comment.

 Tu alignes un écosystème dense. Métiers, produit, data, IT : tu fais converger des parties prenantes multiples vers des décisions cohérentes, et tu accompagnes l'adoption des solutions auprès des équipes.

 Tu documentes ce qui compte. Processus, décisions, dépendances, évolutions fonctionnelles : ce que tu laisses derrière toi tient sans toi.

 Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d'expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

 Tu as travaillé sur des briques IA (recommandation, agents, GenAI) ou tu as une appétence réelle pour intégrer l'IA au cycle produit. On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l'IA partout.

 

 👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ? 
 Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l'IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien.

 Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

 Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.) 

 Des valeurs fortes : depuis 10 ans, Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l'ambition, l'expertise et l'apprentissage.

 Le package : 44.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.
 
 
 Pré-requis du poste 
 👉 Le profil que nous recherchons 
 Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Manager ou Product Owner sur des produits digitaux, dont une expérience significative en écosystème complexe : plusieurs métiers, plusieurs systèmes, des décisions qui ne se prennent jamais seul.

 Tu sais mener un sujet produit de la discovery aux critères d'acceptation, et tu as déjà porté une vision et une feuille de route face à des parties prenantes exigeantes.

 Ta maturité data est réelle : tu interprètes toi-même les chiffres, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider.

 Tu es à l'aise pour contribuer au cadrage fonctionnel de briques applicatives structurantes, sans y perdre ta hauteur de vue produit.

 Un passage par le commerce, le e-commerce ou la supply chain, en particulier sur les sujets d'offre et de référencement, est un vrai plus. Une familiarité avec un progiciel de gestion de type SAP également.

 Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une posture conseil assumée, une excellente communication client et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve. Anglais professionnel.

 
 
 Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ? 
 Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l'adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle

 Etape 2 : Validation de tes hard skills avec cas pratique avec un manager

 Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP

 Etape 4 : Echange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d'embauche

 Quelle que soit l'issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum !
 Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog .

jobs.title: Senior Lead Product Marketing(x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft

Als Senior Lead Product Marketing im Medics Cluster arbeitest Du direkt mit, den größten Produktlaunch von Doctolib in Deutschland zu skalieren: Die All-In-One Praxissoftware, mit der Gesundheitsteams Ende zu Ende alle administrativen und klinischen Arbeitsabläufe vor, während und nach dem Termin steuern können. 
Als Teil unseres lokalen Product Marketing Teams handelst Du wie ein CEO für Deinen Bereich: Du entwickelst die Go-to-Market-Strategie in Deutschland weiter und bist verantwortlich für deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung. Dein Hauptziel ist es, durch innovative Marktstrategien die Ziele für ongeboardete Praxen zu erreichen und die Zufriedenheit unserer Nutzer weiter zu erhöhen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und setzt Go-to-Market-Strategien für Doctolib’s Produkt- und Feature-Launches um
  • Als Stimme unserer Nutzer verbesserst Du kontinuierlich unseren Product-Market-Fit und gestaltest unsere Product Roadmap
  • Gleichzeitig stellt Du sicher, dass wir die Signale unsere Nutzer entlang der Customer Journey verstehen und darauf aufbauend kontinuierlich unsere Value Delivery, Usage, Trust und Customer Experience verbessern
  • Du analysierst Markttrends und die Wettbewerbslandschaft, um strategische Chancen zu identifizieren
  • Du definierst die Produktpositionierung und -botschaften für den deutschen Markt
  • Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams Marketing, Sales, Customer Success sowie Product & Tech zusammen
  • Du managst Feature Releases und stellst deren erfolgreiche Markteinführung sicher
  • Gemeinsam mit anderen Teams verfolgst du regulatorische und technische Rahmenbedingungen und arbeitest mit daran, ein Umfeld für kunden- und nutzerfreundliche Lösungen zu schaffen

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit: 

  • Du hast mindestens 8 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise als Manager:in im Product Marketing oder Go-To-Market Strategie, oder mit einem Hintergrund in der Top-Tier-Managementberatung oder VC - kombiniert mit Product Management Erfahrung
  • Du hast eine ausgeprägt strukturierte und analytische Denk- und Arbeitsweise
  • Du hast bereits eng mit Tech & Product Teams gearbeitet
  • Es fällt Dir leicht, Prioritäten zu setzen, Ressourcen sinnvoll zu allokieren und Projekte strukturiert zu führen, um Go-to-Market Strategien effektiv zu entwickeln und umzusetzen.
  • Du bist erfahren im Management seniorer Stakeholder (VP, MD, Executive Committee)
  • Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Ideen klar und überzeugend zu vermitteln
  • Du sprichst fließend deutsch und englisch (jeweils mindestens C1-Niveau)

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem: 

  • Erfahrung in einem Scale-up-Unternehmen
  • Erfahrung im Medtech-Bereich

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest
  • Eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit tollen Zusatzleistungen
  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)
  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth
  • Die Möglichkeit, bis zu 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten
  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit) 
  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das einen Monat Elternzeit extra u.v.m. enthält
  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner 
  • Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine
  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club
  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

Der Interviewprozess

  • Recruiter Interview
  • Hiring Manager Interview
  • Case Study Interview
  • Finales Interview mit dem VP
  • Referenzen

Job Details

  • Festanstellung in Vollzeit mit attraktivem Gehaltspaket
  • Arbeitsort Berlin
  • 2 Tage Homeoffic

 NeuroNation is the personalised training app that empowers more than 20 million people all over the world in staying brain healthy and happy in their lives.

Our engaging apps have received awards from major health insurance companies, such as the AOK, funded by the German Federal Ministry of Health. Also, we've been awarded by Apple and Google as one of the best apps available. 
 
 
 To improve the training experience our app provides and make the product more effective and engaging to users and patients, we are looking for a passionate person with a background in science and deep interest in digital health and games. Since the role touches many different fields, you don’t have to bring all know-how already with you - we are welcoming passionate learners who want to develop themselves in this role. 
 
 
 So, if you want to help us shape a better tomorrow, join us on our journey! 
 
 
 Your roles and responsibilities 
 
 
 Improve the training experience and the exercises of our mobile and web app by making NeuroNation as effective and engaging as possible
 Continuously incorporate the latest findings from neuroscience by reading scientific papers and learning from concepts that have been proven to have impact on clinical outcomes
 Apply User Research and Usability Testing to learn how we can best help users and patients, and define useful features and visual concepts

jobs.title: Product Manager*in (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Lust auf Produktgestaltung und Innovation? 

 Willst du Features bauen oder echte Probleme lösen?

Wir suchen keinen bloßen „Verwalter von Anforderungen“, sondern einen strategischen Kopf, der unser Produkt zum Marktführer macht. Wir sind ein SaaS-Startup mit einer klaren Mission: Mehrweg in der Logistik so einfach wie Einweg zu machen. Wir reduzieren nicht nur den CO₂-Fußabdruck einer ganzen Branche, sondern optimieren einen ihrer nervigsten Prozesse.

 Als Product Manager bist du nicht dafür da, Tickets zu schreiben. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, dass unser Produkt wertvoll für den Kunden und rentabel für unser Business ist.

 Aufgaben

 
 Product Discovery statt bloßer Ausführung: Du bekommst keine fertigen Lösungen vorgesetzt. Stattdessen arbeitest du eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, um herauszufinden, was wir bauen müssen. Du validierst Hypothesen schnell und minimierst das Risiko, Dinge zu bauen, die niemand braucht.

 Outcome über Output: Dein Erfolg misst sich nicht an der Anzahl der geschriebenen Tickets oder pünktlichen Releases, sondern an messbaren Geschäftsergebnissen (z.B. Adoption-Rate von Features, Prozess-Effizienz beim Kunden).

 Tiefes Kundenverständnis: Du wirst zum Experten für unsere Nutzer. Durch kontinuierliche User Interviews und Datenanalysen verstehst du deren Schmerzpunkte besser als sie selbst und leitest daraus die Produktstrategie ab.

 Business Viability: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Lösungen nicht nur nutzbar sind, sondern auch in unser Geschäftsmodell passen und rechtlich sowie technisch realisierbar sind.

 
 Qualifikation

 
 Liebe zum Problem: Du verstehst den Unterschied zwischen Projekt- und Produktmanagement. Du liebst es, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und übernimmst Verantwortung für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg deines Produktbereichs.

 Evidenzbasierte Entscheidungen: Du verlässt dich nicht auf Bauchgefühl. Du hast Erfahrung mit modernen Discovery-Methoden (Prototyping, A/B-Testing, Customer Interviews) und weißt, wie man Daten nutzt, um Argumente zu stützen.

 Kollaboration & Kommunikation: Du siehst Entwickler und Designer nicht als "Ressourcen", sondern als Partner. Du kannst Stakeholdern souverän "Nein" sagen, um den Fokus auf das Wesentliche zu wahren, und kannst deine Produktvision begeisternd vermitteln.

 Hintergrund: Ein Studium ist gut, echte Erfahrung ist besser. Ob Informatik, BWL oder Quereinsteiger: Wichtig ist, dass du Erfahrung im Bauen digitaler Produkte (SaaS) hast und idealerweise schon einmal in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld (Startup) gearbeitet hast.

 
 Benefits

 
 Dein Buden-Buddy, unsere Welcome-Box sowie eine strukturierte Einführungsphase helfen dir dich schnell bei uns zurechtzufinden und bei uns anzukommen.

 Du erlebst eine positive Teamkultur durch regelmäßige Buden-Spieleabende, wöchentliche Coffee Dates, gemeinsame sportliche Aktivitäten (Firmenläufe,…), spannende Sommerevents, u.v.m.

 Bei der Wahl deines Arbeitsstandorts sind wir flexibel und du entscheidest, ob du ins Büro kommen möchtest oder von Zuhause aus arbeiten möchtest.

 Wir wollen gemeinsam „groß“ werden und freuen uns, wenn du Teil der Reise bist und aktiv an der Entwicklung der Bude mitwirkst.

 Deine Arbeit hat einen nachhaltigen Impact, denn wir verkleinern den CO2-Fußabdruck der Logistik.

 Wähle die Incentives, die zu dir passen: Wir bezuschussen das Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass und das Jobrad.

 Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

 30 Urlaubstage

 Sollte selbstverständlich sein, haben wir aber auch: Kostenlose Getränke, Auswahl deiner Arbeitsgeräte, regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche.

 
 Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

 Balances connectées, montres, tensiomètres, dispositifs médicaux et services digitaux : nos technologies sont aujourd’hui utilisées par des millions de personnes et s’intègrent de plus en plus au parcours de soin.
 Nous cherchons aujourd’hui un(e) Product Manager Healthcare pour contribuer au développement de nos produits et services de santé, notamment autour du Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), du suivi des maladies chroniques et de nouveaux parcours de soin digitaux.
 
 Vos responsabilités 
 Comprendre les besoins des patients, médecins et équipes de soin et les transformer en solutions simples et efficaces.
 Concevoir de nouvelles fonctionnalités Healthcare, en particulier autour du Remote Patient Monitoring et du suivi des maladies chroniques. 
 Développer des outils permettant aux professionnels de santé de mieux exploiter les données Withings, de gagner du temps et d'améliorer la qualité du suivi patient.
 Imaginer des parcours patients favorisant l'engagement, l'éducation thérapeutique et l'adoption de comportements favorables à leur santé.
 Définir la vision produit, les priorités et la roadmap en collaboration avec les équipes Engineering, Design, Medical, Data et Business.
 Définir et suivre les KPI permettant de mesurer l'utilisation et l'impact réel des fonctionnalités développées.
 Étudier le marché, les usages et les évolutions du secteur de la santé digitale afin d'identifier de nouvelles opportunités.
 Transformer rapidement des idées en prototypes afin de les confronter aux utilisateurs avant d'investir dans leur développement.
 Nous recherchons un profil capable d'aller au-delà de la définition fonctionnelle d'un produit.
 Les outils d'IA générative transforment profondément la manière de construire des produits. Nous attendons du Product Manager qu'il sache les utiliser pour accélérer son travail : explorer une idée, analyser des données, créer un prototype fonctionnel, automatiser certaines tâches ou tester une expérience utilisateur.

 Requirements

 Formation Bac+5, idéalement école d'ingénieur ou formation scientifique/technique équivalente.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Position

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Acquisitions & Onboarding team, a domain that touches every customer who plays on FanDuel. You'll work closely with engineering and design to bring initiatives from scoping through delivery, while also contributing to the bigger questions of what we build and why — assessing opportunities, shaping priorities, and utilizing using data to inform decisions.

The Product Manager ensures successful product performance through market analysis, a deep understanding of customer needs, data analysis and reporting. Initiatives will be a mix of back-end and front-end work, with a focus on data recommendations, cutting edge technology and ease of use. There is a great opportunity to work across a range of expert teams to achieve your outcomes.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

 

THE GAME PLAN
Everyone on our team has a part to play

  • Work within a collaborative environment, liaising closely with an extensive list of stakeholders including engineering, marketing, commercial, design & product analytics
  • Contribute to product discovery and prioritization, helping assess opportunities and shape the roadmap alongside your team
  • Build and maintain relationships across engineering, design, data, operations, and other stakeholders to drive alignment and remove blockers
  • Track product performance and use data to identify what's working, what isn't, and what to do about it
  • Develop expertise in the onboarding domain and stay curious about how our product, customers, and landscape evolve
  • Be responsible for eliciting requirements, in the form of user stories & acceptance criteria, prioritizing the product backlog to streamline the execution of program priorities while maintaining the conceptual and technical integrity of the features or components
  • Establish and maintain domain expertise including complex process flows and legal and regulatory requirements for our industry.
  • Drive through effective and sustainable change and guide the business through the journey.
  • Play an integral role in a self-organizing agile delivery team, ensuring solutions adhere to state regulations for our products while serving the needs of each of our products (Sportsbook, Fantasy Sports, Predicts, Racing, and Casino).
  • Understand and communicate the problem whilst putting the customers experience of the product first.

What We’re Looking For

What we’re looking for in our next teammate

    • Bachelor’s degree preferred

    • Excellent numerical and analytical skills with the ability to interpret data quickly to inform the right decisions
    • Experience working with engineering and/or design teams, even in a supporting capacity
    • Naturally resourceful — you ask questions, seek out the right people, and find a path forward even when the answer isn't obvious

 Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
 
Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.
 The team 
 Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.
 Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.
 The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.
  
 The opportunity 
 Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)

 Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases

 Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against

 Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale

 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. 
 
 Innovate with Tether 
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. 
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world.  Are you ready to be part of the future? 
 
 About the job 
 Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design. 
 
 We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role.  Technical Product Leadership
